entries.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one complete transparent lateral combat-idle sprite for the existing Silent Hill Combat roster.
Subject: Rinko-Like Entity from Silent Hill f, exactly the entity shown in the references. Reference image 1 is the source design sheet (several views of the SAME entity, not a requested group); image 2 confirms its in-game head and material colors.
Create ONE whole figure in strict orthographic SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, from the very tip of the tall black ceremonial hat to both complete shoes and the full trailing hair and chain. Both shoulders, hips and head align in side elevation; no front or three-quarter view. Use the source's upright stance with the visible arm slightly away from the body so its hand and chain remain legible. The chain hangs naturally near the feet inside the canvas.
Preserve the unusually tall narrow black hat, the featureless glowing orange-red face, charred ridged outer texture with fine ember lines, broad muted violet patterned ritual robe, dark lower garments, modest low shoes, and extremely long straight dark hair falling behind to the floor. Preserve the silhouette, layered fabric proportions and source weapon; do not add a face, crown, wings, staff or extra weapon. Refer only to this one entity; no puppets or other figures.
Render as a high-detail game character asset with restrained source-like lighting and crisp readable edges, matching the reference colors. The surrounding area must be actual alpha transparency, with no painted checkerboard, scene, floor, cast shadow, label or logo. Keep at least 10 percent clear padding on EVERY side around the entire figure, including hat, hair and chain. One pose only, no panels or sprite sheet. Do not crop any extremity.

Preserve the exceptionally large rounded upper mass, dark navy torn jacket with remnants of light fabric, the source's reddish and pale fungal textures, exactly two short thick legs with both small feet complete, the one large original bladed weapon extending from the weapon-bearing arm, and the opposite broad curved hanging appendage shown in the design. Preserve the character-specific body proportions; do not turn it into an ordinary human or add a normal head, third support, extra limb or another blade.
Match the source's color palette and detailed rendered-game material style. Show the WHOLE knife, all protrusions and both feet without cropping, with at least 10 percent transparent padding on all four sides. One still pose, no action, no other character, no environment or floor, no cast shadow, no labels, no watermark. The background must have actual alpha transparency and clean edges, not a painted checkerboard.

Use actual alpha transparency around the whole silhouette; no scene, ground plane, cast shadow, checkerboard, text, label, logo, contact sheet or duplicate views. Center the figure with at least 10 percent empty padding on every side. No cropped toes, hands, head or tongue.
